projects.title: 5G Antenna Array Design
projects.description: Designed and simulated a 4x4 MIMO antenna array operating at 28 GHz for 5G millimeter-wave applications. Achieved beam steering capability with optimized gain patterns.

projects.title: Digital Communication System Simulator
projects.description: Built a MATLAB-based simulator for various digital modulation schemes (BPSK, QPSK, 16-QAM) with AWGN channel modeling and BER analysis.

projects.title: IoT-Based Environmental Monitoring
projects.description: Developed an IoT system using Arduino and ESP32 to monitor temperature, humidity, and air quality with real-time data visualization on a web dashboard.

experience.title: Network Engineering Intern
experience.description: Assisted in network infrastructure design and maintenance. Gained hands-on experience with fiber optic installations and network monitoring tools.
